name: veeam-mcp
description: Every Veeam Service Provider Console endpoint as a typed command, plus a local multi-tenant mirror, cross-company rollups, and drift detection no per-instance Veeam tool offers.

veeam_base_url.title: VEEAM_BASE_URL
veeam_base_url.description: Your VSPC appliance REST API base URL, e.g. https://vspc.example.com:1280/api/v3. The console is appliance-hosted, so this is per-instance and required.

veeam_token.title: VEEAM_TOKEN
veeam_token.description: Bearer token for the VSPC REST API (POST /token with your portal credentials).

veeam_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
veeam_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 for a read-only server: the API execute tool, sync, import, export and the learning-store writers are hidden, so only reads reach Veeam. Leave blank for the full tool set.

veeam_no_local_data.title: No local data
veeam_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of Veeam data: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, nothing new is written to the local store, and sync is refused.

veeam_mcp_http_token.title: HTTP transport bearer token
veeam_mcp_http_token.description: Bearer token that veeam-mcp --transport http requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer, 32 characters or more). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

veeam_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
veeam_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank: a file sent through an MCP upload must then be base64 file content. Set it to a folder only to let MCP uploads name files inside that folder; no path outside it can be read.

veeam_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
veeam_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Veeam requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
